question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**borne**" is the past participle of **"bear,"** meaning to carry or transport. It is the correct form to use in this context, indicating that the coffin was carried by the undertaker's men.
 
• "**Beared**" and "**bearded**" are incorrect forms and do not fit the context.
 
• "**Bear**" is the base form of the verb and does not fit the past tense context of the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Mr. Reed had been dead for nine__ years: it was in this chamber he __breathed__ his last; here he __lay__ in state; hence his coffin was __borne__ by the undertaker's men; and, since that day, a (5) ___________ of dreary consecration had guarded it from frequent intrusion.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Borne (ले जाया गया)**: means carried or transported,** suitable for past tense use.**
 
• **Beared**: an incorrect verb form.
 
• **Bear (ले जाना)**: base form, not fitting the past participle requirement.
 
• **Bearded**: means having a beard, not applicable in this context.
